meta.title: AngryKitten · Android apps and games with claws
meta.description: Independent app studio from Tashkent. We design, build and launch Android apps, games and websites. 12 apps live on Google Play.

play.body: Android apps and games from Tashkent.

work.body: We design, build and launch Android apps for clients, from first sketch to Google Play.

work.title: Real products, **real users.**
work.body: Marketplaces, money, sign-in, chat and offline storage. The things clients actually hire a studio for.

games.title: Games that **bite back.**
games.body: Nine casual and arcade games, built in-house to sharpen the craft we bring to every client project.

services.title: What we can **build** for you.
services.body: Bring an idea, a sketch or a half-built app. We'll take it from there.
services.notSureBody: Tell us the problem. We'll suggest the right mix.

why.title: Small studio. **Sharp claws.**
why.body: We're small on purpose. You talk to the people who design and build your app, not to an account manager.

items.title: Offline-first
items.body: Most of our apps work without internet. Yours will feel fast on any connection.

items.title: Private by default
items.body: Several of our apps ship with no ads, no accounts and no tracking. We build only what you need.

items.title: Speaks your users' language
items.body: English, Uzbek and Russian built in from day one, not bolted on later.

items.title: Polished to the pixel
items.body: Dark mode, haptics, achievements: the small details that make people stay.

process.title: Sniff. Stalk. **Pounce.** Purr.
process.body: Four clear stages, one shared board, and a working build in your hands as early as possible.

steps.title: Sniff
steps.body: We dig into your idea, your users and your goals, and agree on what to build first.

steps.title: Stalk
steps.body: User flows, then high-fidelity screens you can click through before any code.

steps.title: Pounce
steps.body: Native Android development in short cycles, with builds you can test on your own phone.

steps.title: Purr
steps.body: Store listing, release on Google Play, then updates and support when you need them.

team.title: The people behind the **claws.**
team.body: A small team on purpose. You talk to the people who design and build your app.
